title: Finite-Tor etale-origin witnesses for the purity projection inputs
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], with algebraic closure $k$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. Let $E\subset F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $R=\mathcal O_E\subset S=\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sf-setting]. For $T=X,Y$, put $A_{n,T}=(R/\ell^n)_T$, $B_{n,T}=(S/\ell^n)_T$ on the small pro-etale site, and use the ordinary derived categories of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Write $\mathcal N_A(T),\mathcal N_B(T)$ for their normalized constructible subcategories with uniform cohomological and Tor bounds [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and $C_T=-\otimes^L_{A_{\bullet,T}}B_{\bullet,T}$ for scalar extension of whole systems [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Twists mean [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Write $P_A=Rf_{!,A,\bullet}\dashv G_A=f^!_{A,\bullet}$ and $P_B\dashv G_B$ for the specified tower adjunctions, with units $\eta_A,\eta_B$ and counits $\epsilon_A,\epsilon_B$ [det-sp-tower-gluing]. Fix the same compactification for the two compact-support functors [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. Let $b:C_YP_A\xrightarrow{\sim}P_BC_X$ be the coefficient comparison formed by the proper direct-image coefficient mate followed by the open-extension tensor identification, as in [lem-sp-field-shriek-system-comparison]. Let $c_K:C_XG_AK\xrightarrow{\sim}G_BC_YK$ be the $P_B\dashv G_B$ transpose of $C_Y\epsilon_{A,K}\circ b_{G_AK}^{-1}$ [lem-sp-field-exceptional-system-comparison]. Put $J_{A,T}=(A_{n,T})_n$, $J_{B,T}=(B_{n,T})_n$, $\omega_A=G_AJ_{A,Y}$ and $\omega_B=G_BJ_{B,Y}$. Let $K_\bullet\in\mathcal N_A(Y)$ have common Tor interval $[a,b]$. For each $n\ge1$ there exist bounded constructible etale complexes and specified pro-etale realization isomorphisms for all five objects
$$K_n,\quad(\omega_A)_n,\quad(C_YK)_n,\quad(\omega_B)_n,\quad(C_X\omega_A)_n.$$
Their etale Tor intervals can be taken respectively to be $[a,b]$, $[-2d,-2d]$, $[a,b]$, $[-2d,-2d]$, $[-2d,-2d]$. Etale-origin witnesses and realization mean [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness, lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin], and etale/pro-etale Tor amplitude means [lem-sf-comparison-tor-amplitude]. Given any witness $w_n:\nu_X^*W_n\xrightarrow{\sim}(\omega_B)_n$, a witness for $(C_X\omega_A)_n$ is the specified composite $(c_{J_{A,Y}})_n^{-1}\circ w_n$, using $C_YJ_{A,Y}=J_{B,Y}$. These witnesses satisfy the two-input hypotheses of the tower projection formula [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels](2a) for $(K,\omega_A)$, $(C_YK,\omega_B)$ and $(C_YK,C_X\omega_A)$; each tower is bounded below. The conclusion asks only for witnesses level by level, not a compatible tower of etale witnesses. It holds for ramified fields, with $A_n=A_{E,h_En}$ and $B_n=A_{F,h_Fn}$ when $\ell$ is a unit times the indicated uniformizer powers.
